@@context: Together Ledger: a private shared journey for two or more people. English is the source language. Notes for translators are the @ entries; docs/TRANSLATION.md and locales/glossary.json explain the careful words.
common.journeySettings.title: Journey settings

@common.journeySettings.title.description: The name of the settings for one journey, shown as the title of that panel on the web and as a heading on the phone. A journey is the shared space two or more people keep together; see the glossary.

common.appearance.title: Appearance

@common.appearance.title.description: Heading over the theme choice, in settings on the web and on the phone.

common.theme.label: Theme

@common.theme.label.description: Label of the menu that picks a colour theme (Light, Dark, Green, Flexoki) for this person's own screen.

common.theme.note: Your theme changes only your own view. Each journeyer chooses what feels right on their screen.

@common.theme.note.description: Under the theme menu. Reassures that a theme is personal: changing it never changes what the other people in the journey see. 'Journeyer' is one of the people sharing a journey; see the glossary.

common.language.title: Language

@common.language.title.description: Heading over the menu that chooses the language this person reads the app in, on the web and on the phone. It stays this word in every language, so someone who chose a language by mistake can find the way back.

@common.language.followDevice.description: The first choice in the Language menu: no language chosen by hand, so the app reads in the first of the phone's or browser's own languages it offers, and keeps following them if they change. The other choices are each language's own name in its own script, which are never translated.

common.language.note: Your language changes only your own view. Names, journeys and moments stay as each journeyer wrote them.

@common.language.note.description: Under the Language menu. Reassures that choosing a language never translates or changes what people wrote, and never changes what the other people in the journey read. 'Journeyer' is one of the people sharing a journey; see the glossary.

@common.action.edit.description: Button that opens something to change it. A short verb.

@common.action.delete.description: Button that deletes something. A confirmation always follows, so this is the first step, not the final one.

@common.time.notRecorded.description: Shown in place of a date and time when none was saved.

@settings.dialog.close.description: Spoken label of the × button that closes the journey settings panel on the web. Read by screen readers only.

settings.storage.browserOnly: Browser-only journeys stay on this device unless you download a backup.

@settings.storage.browserOnly.description: Under the settings title on the web, when the person is not signed in and the journey lives only in this browser.

settings.storage.signedIn: This signed-in journey is loaded from the private service. Sign out to return to your browser-only journey.

@settings.storage.signedIn.description: Under the settings title on the web, when the person is signed in and the journey comes from their account.

@settings.theme.menuLabel.description: Spoken label of the theme menu inside settings on the web, so screen readers can tell it from the identical menu in the page header. Read by screen readers only.

settings.backup.title: Backup and restore

@settings.backup.title.description: Heading of the settings section that downloads all of this browser's journeys to a file and brings a file back.

settings.backup.privacy: Exports include every local journey, moment, practical detail, and action milestone. Internal account IDs are replaced with aliases made for that file. The file still contains private journey content, so store it with care.

@settings.backup.privacy.description: What a backup file holds, and that it is private. 'Moment' is something two people hold in their journey; see the glossary.

settings.backup.restoreBoundary: Import replaces this browser’s current ledger only after the whole file passes validation. Export first if you need the current ledger.

@settings.backup.restoreBoundary.description: Warns that importing a file replaces what this browser holds, and only once the whole file checks out. 'Ledger' is everything this browser keeps.

@settings.backup.export.description: Button that downloads a backup file of every journey in this browser.

@settings.backup.import.description: Button that picks a backup file and replaces this browser's journeys with it. Keep both halves: it imports, and it replaces.

@settings.backup.exported.description: Brief message after the backup file has been downloaded.

@settings.backup.imported.description: Brief message after a backup file has replaced this browser's journeys.

settings.reset.title: Start fresh

@settings.reset.title.description: Heading of the settings section that clears this browser's journeys. The button below it has the same English words but is an action; its key is settings.reset.action.

settings.reset.note: Reset clears this browser’s journeys and starts with an empty shared space. Export first if you need a backup.

@settings.reset.note.description: What starting fresh does, under its heading.

@settings.reset.action.description: Button that asks to clear this browser's journeys. A confirmation follows. Same English words as the heading settings.reset.title, but this is a verb on a button.

@settings.reset.confirmTitle.description: Title of the confirmation asked before clearing this browser's journeys. It cannot be undone.

settings.reset.confirmConsequence: This browser begins again with an empty shared space. Export first if you need a backup.

@settings.reset.confirmConsequence.description: What clearing does, in the confirmation.

@settings.reset.confirmAction.description: The button in the confirmation that clears this browser's journeys. It cannot be undone.

settings.reset.done: This browser has a fresh shared space.

@settings.reset.done.description: Brief message after this browser's journeys were cleared.

settings.privacy.title: Privacy boundary

@settings.privacy.title.description: Heading of the settings section that says where journeys are kept.

settings.privacy.note: Browser-only journeys stay in this browser. Signed-in private journeys are loaded from the account service and removed from view on sign-out; signing in never uploads the browser ledger.

@settings.privacy.note.description: Where journeys live: in this browser, or in the person's account. Signing in never sends the browser's journeys anywhere.

history.screen.name: History

@history.screen.name.description: The name of the History screen on the phone, shown when it cannot open yet. History is the journey's record of every change, newest first.

history.screen.title: {journey} history

@history.screen.title.description: Title of the History screen on the phone: the journey's own name, then 'history'.

journey.description: The journey's name, written by the people in it, in any script.

history.screen.lead: Server-authoritative, account-attributed history. HMAC chaining makes database changes detectable; deleted records retain privacy-bounded tombstones.

@history.screen.lead.description: Introduction at the top of History: the record is kept by the server, each change is tied to the account that made it, and tampering is detectable. HMAC is a technical name; keep it as is. A tombstone is the small, private marker left where something was deleted.

history.screen.signedOut: Sign in and open a journey to see its history.

@history.screen.signedOut.description: On the History screen when nobody is signed in.

history.concerns.heading: Return-to conversations

@history.concerns.heading.description: Heading over the return-to conversations: on the phone's History, and on the web's ledger, where they are the second section after the moments. A return-to conversation is something the journeyers want to come back to together.

@history.concerns.start.description: Button that starts a new conversation to come back to.

history.concerns.empty: Nothing to return to yet. Conversations you want to come back to together will appear here.

@history.concerns.empty.description: Shown when there are no conversations to return to.

@history.concern.status.description: Small label on a conversation to return to: still open, or resolved. Shown in capitals on the phone.

status.description: open, or anything else for resolved. Translate only the words inside the braces.

@history.concern.updated.description: When a conversation to return to last changed.

time.description: The date and time, already written for the language.

history.concern.deleted: Conversation deleted. The history keeps a tombstone.

@history.concern.deleted.description: Brief message after a conversation to return to was deleted. The history keeps a small, private marker that it was there.

history.events.heading: Recorded changes

@history.events.heading.description: Heading over the journey's record of every change, newest first.

history.events.empty: No recorded changes yet. Changes appear here as they happen. Activity from before the Event Manager began cannot be reconstructed.

@history.events.empty.description: Shown when the record has no changes yet. The Event Manager is the name of the record-keeping that began on a certain date.

history.event.heading: #{sequence, number, ::group-off} · {summary}

@history.event.heading.description: One change in the record: its number in order, then what happened. Keep the number without thousands separators.

sequence.description: Where this change comes in order, from 1.

summary.description: What happened, as the server recorded it.

@history.event.byline.description: Who made a change, and when.

actor.description: The person's name, in any script, or 'Former journeyer'.

time.description: The date and time, already written for the language.

@history.event.change.description: One value that changed, from what it was to what it became. It follows the name of the value, which is shown in bold and not translated.

history.event.noChange: No field-level value change was stored for this event.

@history.event.noChange.description: Shown inside an opened change that recorded no individual values.

history.event.record: Event ID {id} · Previous {hasPrevious, select, yes {{previous}} other {none}} · server-authoritative{hasHash, select, yes { · Hash {hash}…} other {}}

@history.event.record.description: The technical record of one change: its ID, the ID of the change before it (or none), that the server keeps it, and the start of its tamper-evident hash when there is one. IDs and the hash are machine text; keep them as they come.

hasPrevious.description: yes when there is a change before this one. Translate only the words inside the braces.

hasHash.description: yes when the change has a hash. Translate only the words inside the braces.

hash.description: The first twelve characters of the hash.

common.historyGuide.title: How to read your history

@common.historyGuide.title.description: The guide that explains a journey's history in plain words: the button that opens it, and its title. The same words on the web and the phone.

@common.action.working.description: Shown on a button while what it started is still happening.

@common.consequence.keep.description: The button that answers a consequence question with no: nothing changes. It is the safe way out, and focus starts on it.

@common.consequence.eyebrow.description: Small heading over every question that asks a person to confirm something with a consequence (leaving, deleting, sharing). On the web and the phone.

status.banner.accountService: The account service could not complete that request.

@status.banner.accountService.description: Shown when the account service failed with nothing more specific to say.

register.form.created: Account created. Check your email to verify it.
register.form.createdDelayed: Account created, but email is delayed. Use resend verification shortly.

@register.form.createdDelayed.description: Message after creating an account when the verification email could not go yet.

common.account.verificationResent: A new verification link is on its way.

@common.account.verificationResent.description: After asking for the verification email again.

common.account.verificationDelayed: Email delivery is still unavailable. Please try again later.

@common.account.verificationDelayed.description: When the verification email still cannot be sent.

signIn.toast.emailVerified: Email verified. You can now accept invitations.

@signIn.toast.emailVerified.description: Message after opening the link in a verification email.

common.account.recoverySent: If that account exists, a recovery link is on its way.

@common.account.recoverySent.description: After asking for a link to set a new password. It never says whether the account exists.

common.account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in again on every device.

@common.account.passwordChanged.description: After a new password is set from a recovery link.

common.account.passwordsDiffer: The new passwords do not match.

@common.account.passwordsDiffer.description: When the new password and its confirmation are different.

common.account.signedOutEverywhere: Signed out on every device, this one included. Sign in again to continue.

@common.account.signedOutEverywhere.description: After signing out on every device at once.

signIn.status.signedOutHere: This device was signed out. This can happen when the password is changed, when Sign out everywhere is used, or when a sign-in runs out. Sign in again to continue.

@signIn.status.signedOutHere.description: Shown above the sign-in form when the account service ended this device’s sign-in. Sign out everywhere is a button’s name. The phone says the same words.

common.account.passwordChangedHere: Password changed. Every other device was signed out, and this one stays signed in.

@common.account.passwordChangedHere.description: After changing the password while signed in.

@common.status.loading.description: Shown while a screen is loading.

welcome.hero.eyebrow: A shared journey, held with care

@welcome.hero.eyebrow.description: Small line above the welcome page’s main heading.

common.welcome.headline: Keep what matters, {together}

@common.welcome.headline.description: The welcome headline. {together} is the end of the sentence (common.welcome.headlineTogether), set in italics; keep it where it belongs in your sentence.

@welcome.hero.titleEmphasis.description: The words of welcome.hero.title that are drawn in italics. Copy them exactly as they appear in your welcome.hero.title, or nothing is italic.

welcome.hero.intro: A private place for two people to hold the moments, plans, and memories they want to come back to—without the noise of a feed.

@welcome.hero.intro.description: Under the welcome’s main heading: what the product is.

@common.action.notNow.description: Button that puts a choice off without answering it: an invitation, or connecting a Google or Apple sign-in to an account.

@common.account.settings.description: Name of the panel for a person’s own account (their name, email, password, signing out), and of the button that opens it.

@common.account.delete.description: The row in Settings that opens the screen that deletes the account. Nothing is deleted until that screen asks again.

@header.theme.menuLabel.description: Spoken name of the theme menu in the welcome page’s header.

@common.themeName.light.description: Name of the light colour theme, in the theme menus and on a moment’s theme choice.

@common.themeName.dark.description: Name of the dark colour theme, in the theme menus and on a moment’s theme choice.

@common.themeName.green.description: Name of the dark green colour theme, in the theme menus and on a moment’s theme choice.

@common.themeName.flexoki.description: Name of a warm paper colour theme. Flexoki is the name its designer gave it: keep it as it is, in Latin letters.

account.dialog.copy: Passwords are never shared between journeyers.

@common.account.nameLabel.description: Label of the field for the name the other people in a journey see. A journeyer is one of the people sharing a journey; see the glossary.

common.account.nameSaved: Name saved. Your journeyers see it now.

@common.account.resendVerification.description: Button that sends the email with the verification link again.

@common.action.sending.description: Shown on a button while an email (a recovery link, an invitation) is being sent.

@common.account.signOut.description: Button that signs out on this phone.

@common.account.signOutEverywhere.description: Button that signs out on every device at once, this one included. A question is asked first.

@common.account.signingOut.description: What Sign out everywhere says while it works.

@common.account.changePassword.description: Button on Account settings that opens the screen that changes the password.

@common.action.signIn.description: Button and heading for signing in to an account with a password, Google or Apple.

@signIn.form.identifier.description: Label of the first sign-in box.

@signIn.form.pending.description: Shown on Sign in while it works.

@signIn.form.forgot.description: Link-like button under the sign-in form: opens account recovery.

@common.account.createAccount.description: Button on sign-in that opens the screen that creates an account. A verb phrase; that screen's title is mobile.screen.register.title.

signIn.social.nameHint: A new account starts with your first name. You can change it in Account settings.

@signIn.social.nameHint.description: Under the Google and Apple buttons.

common.account.appleNoEmail: Apple didn’t share an email address.

@common.account.appleNoEmail.description: In place of the email of an account opened with Apple's Hide My Email turned off.

register.form.usernameHelp: 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers, or single hyphens. It is for signing in and is not shown to your journeyer. You can choose the names used together when a journey calls for them.

@register.form.usernameHelp.description: Under the username box. A username is written in Latin letters only.

register.form.passwordHelp: Use at least 12 characters. We send a verification link before invitations can be accepted.

@register.form.passwordHelp.description: Under the new account’s password box.

@register.form.pending.description: Shown on that button while it works.

@common.signIn.connect.description: Button that connects the Google or Apple sign-in to the account and signs in.

@common.signIn.connecting.description: What the connect button says while it works.

signIn.social.label: Continue with Google or Apple

@signIn.social.label.description: Spoken name of the Google and Apple sign-in buttons together. Google and Apple are company names.

@signIn.social.or.description: Between the Google and Apple buttons and the password form.

@common.signIn.thisEmail.description: Stands in for an email address the service did not give, inside "Password for {email}".

common.signOutEverywhere.consequence: Every device signed in to this account, this one included, will need to sign in again. Nothing in your journeys is deleted.

@common.signOutEverywhere.consequence.description: What signing out everywhere does, asked before it happens.

common.signOutEverywhere.title: Sign out everywhere?

@common.signOutEverywhere.title.description: Question asked before signing out on every device.

common.ledger.title: Our ledger

@common.ledger.title.description: Title of the ledger while it has no journey to show. A ledger is everything a journey keeps.

@moment.card.shareNow.description: Button on a moment that waits to be shared: share it with everyone in the journey. It can’t be undone.

home.trip.label: Your shared space

@home.trip.label.description: Small label above the open journey’s name, and the spoken name of that bar.

@common.ledger.newJourney.description: Button that starts a new journey. The ＋ stays.

@home.sharedJourney.eyebrow.description: Small line above the ledger’s moments, and above the form that holds a moment.

home.moments.copy: Hold what happened in words that feel true.

@home.moments.emptyTitle.description: Title shown when a journey has no moments.

home.moments.emptyBody: A small truth is enough to begin.

@home.threads.eyebrow.description: Small line above the ledger’s return-to conversations.

home.threads.lead: A place to hold something you want to come back to together.

@home.threads.lead.description: Under the Return-to conversations heading on the ledger.

@home.threads.emptyTitle.description: Shown when no return-to conversation is open.

home.threads.emptyBody: That can be a good place to rest.

@home.threads.emptyBody.description: Under No open threads: having none is fine.

@home.moments.beginEyebrow.description: Small line above the moments while the ledger is empty.

@home.moments.beginTitle.description: Heading over the moments while the ledger is empty.

home.moments.beginCopy: A ledger can hold the things you want to remember, name, or return to. It begins empty.

@home.moments.beginCopy.description: Under that heading while the ledger is empty.

home.moments.possibilities: There are no examples here—only possibilities:

@home.moments.possibilities.description: Above the kinds of moment shown as suggestions in an empty ledger.

signIn.toast.accountReady: Account ready. Create your first private journey.

@signIn.toast.accountReady.description: Message after signing in to an account with no private journey yet.

@common.visibility.private.description: Who can see a moment: only the person who held it. Shown on the moment and as a choice when holding one.

@common.visibility.shareLater.description: Who can see a moment: only its holder for now, until they choose to share it.

@common.visibility.sharedNow.description: Who can see a moment: everyone in the journey, including anyone who joins later.

@common.momentKind.sharedNote.description: Label on a moment whose own kind was left without a name.

@common.momentKind.moment.description: Label on a moment whose kind is not known.

@home.trip.beganUnknown.description: Part of the line under the journey’s name: nobody remembers exactly when it began. Parts are separated by ·.

@home.trip.began.description: Part of the line under the journey’s name.

date.description: The day it began, already written for the reader.

@home.trip.noEnd.description: Part of the line under the journey’s name: the journey goes on.

@home.trip.endUnsure.description: Part of the line under the journey’s name.

@home.trip.ends.description: Part of the line under the journey’s name.

date.description: The day it ends, already written for the reader.

home.moments.seeAll: {count, plural, one {See all {count, number, ::group-off} moment} other {See all {count, number, ::group-off} moments}}

@home.moments.seeAll.description: Button that shows every moment, not only the recent ones.

count.description: How many moments the journey has.

moment.card.money: {amount} is held here as context, not a score.

amount.description: An amount of money, already written.

@common.momentKind.promise.description: A kind of moment: something promised. One of the suggestions in the Kind of moment menu, and the label on a moment.

@common.momentKind.acknowledgment.description: A kind of moment: something one person recognised in the other.

@common.momentKind.trigger.description: A kind of moment: something that set off a strong reaction. Gentle, not clinical.

@common.momentKind.missedChance.description: A kind of moment: a moment that passed without being taken.

@common.momentKind.heartToHeart.description: A kind of moment: an honest, close conversation.

@common.momentKind.memory.description: A kind of moment: something to remember.

@common.momentKind.feeling.description: A kind of moment: a feeling named.

@common.momentKind.boundary.description: A kind of moment: a limit someone asked to be kept.

@common.momentKind.repairRequest.description: A kind of moment: asking to make something right between the people.

@common.momentKind.learnedSomething.description: A kind of moment: something one person learned.

@common.momentKind.callMe.description: A kind of moment: asking the other person to call.

@common.momentKind.calledYou.description: A kind of moment: noting that one person called the other.

@common.momentKind.practicalMatter.description: A kind of moment: a practical detail, such as a booking or a cost.

@common.momentKind.addYourOwn.description: The last choice in the Kind of moment menu: the person names the kind themselves. Keep the + at the start.

@common.moment.visibilitySpoken.description: What a screen reader says for a moment's visibility mark.

visibility.description: Private, Share later or Shared now (common.visibility.*).

@moment.photo.removed.description: A photo that was taken off a moment and is kept only for the record.

@moment.photo.fallbackName.description: Stands in for a photo’s file name when it has none.

moment.money.title: Practical money context

@moment.money.title.description: An amount of money a moment can hold: the label of that optional field, and the title of the fold that shows it on a moment. Money is context here, never a score.

@moment.card.heldBy.description: At the foot of a moment: who held (kept) it.

name.description: A journeyer’s name, as they wrote it, in any script.

@common.person.journeyMember.description: Stands in for a person’s name when the name could not be read. A journeyer is one of the people sharing a journey; see the glossary.

moment.card.shapedByMore: Shaped by more than one journeyer

@moment.card.shapedByMore.description: Tag on a moment more than one person has changed.

moment.photo.label: Photo

@moment.photo.label.description: Small label on a photo attached to a moment.

@moment.form.editTitle.description: Title of the same form when changing a moment.

moment.form.themeSampleBody: The theme stays with this card. The page around it stays yours.
moment.form.hostedCopy: Choose whether this stays with you, is shared now, or waits until you are ready.

@moment.form.hostedCopy.description: Under the form’s title, in a private journey on the account service.

@moment.form.kind.description: Label of the menu of kinds of moment.

moment.form.name: A short name
moment.form.namePlaceholder: e.g. A quiet apology after dinner
moment.form.detailPlaceholder: Use your own words. Keep it simple and kind.
moment.form.themeHelp: Use your theme, or choose one calm card treatment that every journeyer will see.

@common.momentTheme.own.description: A moment’s theme choice: the moment takes each reader’s own theme rather than one of its own.

@moment.form.placeLabel.description: Spoken name of the box for writing a place.

moment.form.placePlaceholder: Enter a place in your own words

@moment.form.addPlace.description: Button that adds the written place to the moment.

@moment.form.removePlace.description: Spoken name of the Remove button beside a place.

place.description: The place, as the person wrote it.

@common.action.remove.description: Button that takes one item (a place on a moment, a person from a journey) away. Never used for a person leaving on their own.

@moment.form.visibility.description: Label of the choice of who can see a moment: Private, Shared now, Share later.

moment.form.visibilityShared: Already shared: everyone in this journey can see this moment, including anyone who joins later. Prior access cannot be undone.

@moment.form.visibilityShared.description: Under the visibility choice when changing a moment that is already shared.

moment.form.visibilityHosted: Private stays with you. Shared now opens it to everyone in this journey, including anyone who joins later. Share later stays with you until you deliberately share it.

@moment.form.visibilityHosted.description: Under the visibility choice in a private journey. Use the same words as common.visibility.*.

@common.currency.none.description: A choice of currency for a moment's amount. The currency choice for no currency at all.

@common.currency.usd.description: A choice of currency for a moment's amount. Keep the code USD.

@common.currency.eur.description: A choice of currency for a moment's amount. Keep the code EUR.

@common.currency.gbp.description: A choice of currency for a moment's amount. Keep the code GBP.

@common.currency.cad.description: A choice of currency for a moment's amount. Keep the code CAD.

@common.currency.aud.description: A choice of currency for a moment's amount. Keep the code AUD.

@common.currency.jpy.description: A choice of currency for a moment's amount. Keep the code JPY.

@common.currency.inr.description: A choice of currency for a moment's amount. Keep the code INR.

@moment.form.themePreview.description: Small label on the example card that shows the chosen theme.

common.moment.previewHelp: {theme} · exactly as this moment will appear in the ledger.

@moment.form.saveChanges.description: Button that saves changes to a moment.

@moment.form.save.description: Button that keeps a new moment.

@common.action.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog without saving or doing anything.

common.moment.moneyProblem: Enter a valid optional money context.

@common.moment.moneyProblem.description: When the amount is not a number from 0 to 1,000,000.

moment.form.tooManyPlaces: A moment can hold up to 12 places.

@moment.form.tooManyPlaces.description: Shown when a thirteenth place is added.

@moment.form.shared.description: Message after holding a moment shared with everyone in the journey.

@moment.form.heldWithYou.description: Message after holding a moment only its holder can see for now.

common.moment.deleteSharedConsequence: “{title}” will be removed for everyone in this journey. The journey’s history will still show that it was deleted, and who deleted it.

@common.moment.deleteSharedConsequence.description: Asked before deleting a shared moment. It cannot be undone.

common.moment.deletePrivateConsequence: “{title}” will be removed. Only you could see it, so it leaves nothing behind that anyone else can see.

@common.moment.deletePrivateConsequence.description: Asked before deleting a moment only this person could see. It cannot be undone.

moment.share.title: Share this moment now?

@moment.share.title.description: Question before sharing a moment that was waiting. It can’t be undone.

moment.share.consequence: Everyone in this journey will be able to see it, including anyone who joins later. That access cannot be undone.

@common.history.none.description: In a journey's history, in place of a value that was empty before or after a change: "none → Dark". Lower case, as it sits inside a line.

@common.person.formerJourneyer.description: Stands in for the name of someone who is no longer in the journey. Nobody is “removed” in this product’s voice; see the glossary.

common.concern.deleteTitle: Delete this conversation to return to?

@common.concern.deleteTitle.description: Question asked before deleting a conversation to return to.

common.concern.deleteConsequence: “{title}” will be removed. The event history keeps a deletion tombstone, so the change stays attributable.

@common.concern.deleteConsequence.description: What deleting a conversation does, asked before it happens. A tombstone is the record that it was deleted, and by whom.

@common.concern.deleteAction.description: The button that deletes the conversation. It cannot be undone.

@error.server.authenticationRequired.description: The action needs the person to be signed in.

error.server.rateLimitExceeded: Too many requests. Wait and try again.

@error.server.rateLimitExceeded.description: The service is refusing for a while because too much was asked of it too fast.

error.server.accountExists: That email or username is already in use.

@error.server.accountExists.description: Creating an account with an email or username another account has.

error.server.emailInUse: An account already uses this email. Sign in the way you did before.

@error.server.emailInUse.description: Signing in with Google or Apple with an email another account uses.

error.server.identityInUse: That sign-in already belongs to another account.

@error.server.identityInUse.description: Connecting a Google or Apple sign-in that another account holds.

error.signIn.invalidCredentials: Username, email, or password is incorrect.

@error.signIn.invalidCredentials.description: Shown when signing in fails. It never says which one was wrong, on purpose.

error.moment.conflict: This moment changed on another device.

@error.moment.conflict.description: From the service, when saving a moment: someone changed it elsewhere since this form opened, so nothing was saved.

@mobile.account.checking.description: While the phone asks the service who is signed in.

@mobile.account.who.description: The person's name and email, on Account settings.

name.description: A person's name as they chose it, in any script.

email.description: The account's email, or words saying Apple shared none.

@mobile.account.emailVerified.description: On Account settings, when the email address is confirmed.

mobile.account.emailNotVerified: Email not verified yet. Invitations can be accepted once it is.

@mobile.account.emailNotVerified.description: On Account settings, when the email address is not confirmed yet.

mobile.account.nameHint: Everyone in your journeys sees this name, and each journey notes when it changes. Your handle, @{handle}, stays private.

handle.description: The account's username, shown after @. Never translated.

mobile.account.verifiedInBrowser: I verified it in my browser

@mobile.account.verifiedInBrowser.description: Button for someone who opened the verification link in their browser: the phone checks again.

mobile.account.signOutNote: Signing out removes hosted journeys from this view without deleting them.

@mobile.account.signOutNote.description: Above Sign out: signing out never deletes a journey.

common.account.noEmailSupport: For help with this account, write to ledger-support@together-ledger.com.

@common.account.noEmailSupport.description: For an account with no email address, which can't be sent one. Selectable so the address can be copied; keep it exactly as it is.

@mobile.action.tryAgain.description: Button that tries the same thing again, after something failed or could not be reached.

@mobile.action.saving.description: What a button says while it saves.

mobile.error.offline: You’re offline. A moment you hold now waits on this phone and is sent when you reconnect. Your journeys will be back then; until then, nothing else can be changed.

@mobile.error.offline.description: Shown while the phone has no connection, standing at the top of each screen, and when something is tried without one. Only holding a new moment can wait; nothing else can be changed until the connection returns.

mobile.error.unreachable: Together Ledger can’t be reached right now. You’re still signed in. Try again in a moment.

@mobile.error.unreachable.description: When the phone has a connection but the service did not answer. Together Ledger is the product's name and is never translated.

error.server.accountsUnavailable: Private accounts are being connected. No account details were sent.

@error.server.accountsUnavailable.description: This copy of the website can’t reach accounts yet. Nothing was sent.

error.client.fallback: The service could not complete that request.

@error.client.fallback.description: When the service refused something and gave no reason that can be shown, on the web and the phone.

mobile.error.notFromTheApp: That cannot be done from the app.

@mobile.error.notFromTheApp.description: When something can only be done on the website, said without pointing there.

mobile.history.noJourney: Your account is ready. Create a private journey, and its history will be here.

@mobile.history.noJourney.description: History, signed in but with no journey yet.

@mobile.invitation.haveOne.description: Button on the welcome, the empty ledger and sign-in, for someone who was invited to join a journey. It opens a place to paste the invitation.

@mobile.journey.opening.description: Under the row of journeys, while the journey just chosen is loading. The one open stays on screen meanwhile.

journey.description: The journey's name, in any script, as the people in it wrote it.

mobile.journey.opensWhenBack: “{journey}” opens once the connection is back.

@mobile.journey.opensWhenBack.description: Under the row of journeys, when a journey was chosen while the connection was lost.

journey.description: The journey's name, in any script, as the people in it wrote it.

mobile.journey.screenOpensWhenBack: {screen} opens once the connection is back.

@mobile.journey.screenOpensWhenBack.description: In place of a screen that needs a journey, such as History, while the phone is offline.

mobile.journey.notLoaded: Your journeys couldn’t be loaded just now.

@mobile.journey.notLoaded.description: When the journeys failed to load for a reason other than the connection. Why is said above it, in the status message.

@mobile.ledger.journeys.description: What a screen reader calls the row of journeys to choose between.

mobile.moment.noRoomForPlace: This moment has no room for another place. Room belongs to the journey, and is the same on every device. Remove a place to save the moment.

@mobile.moment.noRoomForPlace.description: When saving a moment with more places than its journey has room for. Room is not a seat or a slot; see the glossary's another place.

mobile.moment.noRoomForPhoto: This moment has no room for another photo. Room belongs to the journey, and is the same on every device.

@mobile.moment.noRoomForPhoto.description: When adding a photo a moment has no room for.

mobile.moment.keptOnPhone: Kept on this phone. It will be sent when the connection returns.

@mobile.moment.keptOnPhone.description: Brief message after holding a moment while offline.

@moment.photo.alt.description: Description of a photo on a moment, for screen readers.

title.description: The moment’s short name, as its journeyer wrote it.

@mobile.moment.photoFailed.description: When a photo on a moment could not be loaded.

mobile.moment.gone: This moment is no longer here. It may have been deleted on another device.

@mobile.moment.gone.description: When the moment being edited no longer exists.

mobile.moment.noJourney: Open a journey first, then hold a moment in it.

@mobile.moment.noJourney.description: When the form to hold a moment is opened with no journey open.

@mobile.moment.backToLedger.description: Button that closes the form and goes back to the ledger.

mobile.moment.kindHelp: Choose a suggestion, or make one your own.
mobile.moment.whenHint: Year, month and day, such as 2026-09-30.

@mobile.moment.whenHint.description: Under the date field: how to type a day. The example date is typed as digits, year first.

@mobile.moment.calendar.description: Button that opens the phone's calendar to pick the day.

mobile.moment.detail: What would you like to hold? (Optional)

@mobile.moment.detail.description: Label of the field for what happened, in the person's own words.

@mobile.moment.themeTitle.description: Heading over the colour treatments a moment can wear.

@moment.form.theme.description: Label of the choice of colours for this one moment’s card. Optional is shown beside it.

@mobile.moment.placesTitle.description: Heading over the places held with a moment.

mobile.moment.placesHelp: Add only what helps tell the story.

@mobile.moment.chosen.description: Beside the visibility that is chosen.

mobile.moment.moneyTitle: Practical money context (Optional; never counted as a score)

@mobile.moment.moneyTitle.description: Heading over the amount of money a moment can hold.

@mobile.moment.deleteZoneTitle.description: Heading of the marked box at the foot of the edit form that deletes the moment.

mobile.moment.deleteZoneNote: Deleting removes this moment from the ledger, and it can’t be undone. You’ll be asked once more before anything is deleted.

@mobile.moment.deleteZoneNote.description: Under Delete this moment, before the button.

@mobile.moment.delete.description: Button that deletes the moment, after one more question. It cannot be undone.

mobile.moment.kindNameProblem: A name for this kind of moment is required and must be 60 characters or fewer.

@mobile.moment.kindNameProblem.description: When the name for a kind of moment of one's own is empty or too long.

@mobile.moment.dateProblem.description: When the date typed is not a real day.

mobile.moment.titleTooLong: Moment title is required and must be 120 characters or fewer.

@mobile.moment.titleTooLong.description: When the moment's name is too long.

@mobile.moment.deleteQuestion.description: Question asked before deleting a moment.

@mobile.moment.deleted.description: Brief message after a moment is deleted.

@mobile.navigation.backTo.description: What a screen reader says for Android's back button, which goes to the screen named.

screen.description: The title of the screen the button goes back to.

mobile.offline.stillSignedIn: This phone is offline. You’re still signed in.

@mobile.offline.stillSignedIn.description: In Settings, under Account settings, while the phone has no connection.

mobile.offline.stillSignedInUnreachable: Together Ledger can’t be reached right now. You’re still signed in.

@mobile.offline.stillSignedInUnreachable.description: In Settings, under Account settings, while the service does not answer.

mobile.offline.ledger: This phone is offline. You’re still signed in, and your journeys will be back here when it reconnects.

@mobile.offline.ledger.description: In the ledger, in place of the journeys, while the phone has no connection. Journeys are not kept on the phone.

mobile.offline.account: This phone is offline. You’re still signed in, and your account will be here when it reconnects.

@mobile.offline.account.description: On Account settings, in place of the account, while the phone has no connection.

mobile.offline.unreachableHere: Together Ledger can’t be reached right now. You’re still signed in on this phone. Try again in a moment.

@mobile.offline.unreachableHere.description: In the ledger or on Account settings, while the service does not answer.

mobile.screen.welcome.title: Welcome

@mobile.screen.welcome.title.description: The welcome screen's name, said by the back button of the screen opened from it. The welcome itself shows no title bar.

mobile.screen.ledger.title: Ledger

@mobile.screen.ledger.title.description: Name of the main screen, in its title bar and on the back button of screens opened from it. The ledger is where a journey's moments are kept.

mobile.screen.settings.title: Settings

@mobile.screen.settings.title.description: Title of the Settings screen, and the back button of screens opened from it. A noun naming the screen; the button that opens it is mobile.settings.open.

register.form.title: Create account

@register.form.title.description: Heading of the form that creates an account.

mobile.screen.recovery.title: Account recovery

@mobile.screen.recovery.title.description: Title of the screens that send and use a link to set a new password.

mobile.screen.verifyEmail.title: Verify email

@mobile.screen.verifyEmail.title.description: Title of the screen that confirms an email address from a link.

mobile.screen.changePassword.title: Change password

@mobile.screen.changePassword.title.description: Title of the screen that changes the password while signed in.

mobile.screen.invite.title: Invitation

@mobile.screen.invite.title.description: Title of the screen showing an invitation to join a journey.

mobile.screen.deleteAccount.title: Delete account

@mobile.screen.deleteAccount.title.description: Title of the screen that explains and deletes the account. It cannot be undone.

moment.form.title: Hold a moment

@moment.form.title.description: Title of the form for keeping a new moment.

mobile.screen.newJourney.title: New journey

@mobile.screen.newJourney.title.description: Title of the form that starts a new journey.

sharing.section.title: Journey sharing

@sharing.section.title.description: Heading in Journey settings over who is in the journey and how to add someone.

mobile.screen.privacy.title: Privacy

@mobile.screen.privacy.title.description: Title of the screen showing the privacy policy.

mobile.screen.terms.title: Terms of use

@mobile.screen.terms.title.description: Title of the screen showing the terms of use.

mobile.screen.concern.title: Return-to conversation

@mobile.screen.concern.title.description: Title of the form for one conversation the people in a journey want to come back to together.

@mobile.settings.open.description: The button that opens Settings, on the welcome and in the ledger's top bar. A gear is drawn before it and is never read aloud. The screen's own title is mobile.screen.settings.title.

@mobile.settings.openWaiting.description: The Settings button in the ledger's top bar while there are questions about who joins a journey waiting for this person's answer: the word, then how many. Keep it short; it sits in the top bar.

count.description: How many questions wait for an answer, at least 1.

@mobile.settings.openWaitingSpoken.description: What a screen reader says for the Settings button while questions wait for this person's answer (mobile.settings.openWaiting).

count.description: How many questions wait for an answer, at least 1.

mobile.settings.signIn: Sign in or create an account

@mobile.settings.signIn.description: The row in Settings when nobody is signed in on this phone.

@mobile.settings.journeyHeading.description: Heading of the group in Settings for the journey that is open, with its name.

journey.description: The journey's name, in any script, as the people in it wrote it.

@mobile.settings.sharing.description: The row in Settings that opens who is in the journey, invitations and proposals.

@mobile.settings.sharingWaiting.description: The Sharing row while questions about who joins wait for this person's answer.

count.description: How many questions wait for an answer, at least 1.

@mobile.settings.history.description: The row in Settings that opens the journey's history and its conversations to return to.

@mobile.settings.privacy.description: Link at the foot of Settings to the privacy policy.

@mobile.settings.terms.description: Link at the foot of Settings to the terms of use. The screen it opens has the same words as its title (mobile.screen.terms.title).

@mobile.settings.help.description: Link at the foot of Settings that shows where to write for help.

mobile.settings.helpText: For help using Together Ledger, write to ledger-support@together-ledger.com. For anything about your privacy or your data, write to legal@together-ledger.com.

@mobile.settings.helpText.description: Shown when Help is opened, and selectable so the addresses can be copied. Keep both email addresses exactly as they are.

@mobile.settings.build.description: What a screen reader says for the line at the foot of Settings naming this version of the app, to quote in a report.

build.description: The version, build number and commit. Never translated.

mobile.signIn.connectTitle: {provider, select, apple {Connect Apple to your account} other {Connect Google to your account}}

@mobile.signIn.connectTitle.description: Heading when a Google or Apple sign-in uses an email that already has a password account: the password is asked for once to connect them. Apple and Google are names and are never translated.

provider.description: apple or google; chooses the branch, never shown.

@mobile.signIn.connectPassword.description: Label of the password field when connecting a Google or Apple sign-in to an account.

@mobile.signOut.waitingTitle.description: Question asked before signing out while moments held offline have not been sent.

mobile.signOut.waitingConsequence: {count, plural, one {One moment you held hasn’t been sent yet. Signing out removes it from this phone, and it can’t be sent later.} other {{count, number} moments you held haven’t been sent yet. Signing out removes them from this phone, and they can’t be sent later.}}

@mobile.signOut.waitingConsequence.description: What signing out does to moments not sent yet. It cannot be undone.

count.description: How many moments wait, at least 1.

mobile.signOut.waitingAction: {count, plural, one {Sign out and remove it} other {Sign out and remove them}}

@mobile.signOut.waitingAction.description: The button that signs out and removes the moments not sent yet.

count.description: How many moments wait, at least 1.

mobile.signOutEverywhere.waitingTitle: Sign out everywhere with moments waiting?

@mobile.signOutEverywhere.waitingTitle.description: The same question, while moments held offline have not been sent.

@mobile.signOutEverywhere.waitingConsequ.description: Two sentences together: what signing out everywhere does (common.signOutEverywhere.consequence), then what it does to the moments not sent yet (mobile.signOut.waitingConsequence). Change only the space between them if your language joins sentences differently.

mobile.signOutEverywhere.waitingAction: {count, plural, one {Sign out everywhere and remove it} other {Sign out everywhere and remove them}}

@mobile.signOutEverywhere.waitingAction.description: The button that signs out on every device and removes the moments not sent yet.

count.description: How many moments wait, at least 1.

mobile.start.signedOut: Your private journeys appear here once you sign in on this phone.

@mobile.start.signedOut.description: On the ledger, when nobody is signed in on this phone.

@mobile.store.restore.description: The row in Settings that asks the App Store or Google Play for what this account bought, so it is honoured again on this phone.

@mobile.store.restoring.description: What Restore purchases says while it asks the App Store or Google Play.

@mobile.theme.followPhone.description: The first theme choice: follow the phone's own light or dark setting.

@mobile.theme.followsPhone.description: Brief message after choosing Match this phone.

@common.theme.applied.description: Short message after choosing a colour theme.

theme.description: The theme’s name, as the menu shows it.

@mobile.welcome.begin.description: The welcome's main button, which opens the ledger for the first time. The arrow stays.

@common.language.preview.description: A language in a language menu that is offered before it is approved: its own name, then the word Preview, in the reader’s language.

language.description: The language’s own name, in its own script.

@mobile.language.current.description: What a screen reader says for the small language control at the top of the welcome, which opens the Language choice.

language.description: The name of the language the app is in, in its own script.

moment.form.nameMissing: Give this moment a short name.

@moment.form.nameMissing.description: Shown when a moment is held without a name (or only spaces). The same words on the web and the phone.
